definitions.explanation: The art and skill of calculating with a そろばん (abacus). Often refers to the school subject or after-school class where children learn this skill.

examples.japanese: {珠算|しゅざん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{珠算|しゅざん}{二級|にきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: She has a second-rank abacus certification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{珠算|しゅざん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{暗算|あんざん}→暗算：15852_anzan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
examples.english: Thanks to learning abacus as a child, I'm still good at mental arithmetic.

notes:
{珠|しゅ} refers to the beads of the abacus; {算|さん} means 'calculation.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {珠算|しゅざん}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧: abacus class/school
- {珠算|しゅざん}⟦{検定|けんてい}→検定：13131_kentei⟧: abacus proficiency exam
- {珠算|しゅざん}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: abacus competition

CULTURAL NOTE:
The abacus remains a popular after-school activity in Japan, valued for building number sense and mental-calculation speed. Proficiency is measured by ranked levels (⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧ and ⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧), the same grading system used in martial arts. Advanced students can perform large calculations mentally by visualizing the abacus.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- そろばん: the abacus itself (the physical device) — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{暗算|あんざん}→暗算：15852_anzan⟧: mental arithmetic — calculation without any tool
